title: Nathan
summary: Raleigh names Nathan in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Nathan the Prophet, named with Ahia Silonites and Ieedo the Seer. The contents line that Ioas did not descend from Nathan is the same name. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Contents, Book II, Part I, Chapter XXI, sig. 32a
